snippet_primary: "Fans can go to their Billing History and select the payment they'd like refunded. They must request a refund within 60 days of the original payment. If they are outside this window, they will be directed to contact Patreon Product Support for further assistance."
subject_exact: fan self-service refunds via Billing History within 60 days of payment, with later requests routed to Patreon Product Support
